summary: Linux failure artifact confirmed EADDRINUSE on127.0.0.1:8799 in the installed-server smoke. Fixture now resolves the installed packed server manifest bin and starts that file directly with process.execPath; timeout owns the server instead of npx. Kernel-assigned PORT0 prevents cross-checkout collisions. The original post-listen startup oracle remains and new assertions require ETIMEDOUT, SIGTERM, positive PID, and ESRCH for that PID after timeout. Complete SL012 command passed twice sequentially under Node22.23.2/npm10.9.9 (8/8 each,20.1s and18.0s). Current unchanged W014 SLC01 library, SLC02 actual CLI/MCP, and SLC03 UI/navigation/API suites passed63/63. Only this breaker fixture changed; production unchanged.
